svg.title: Per-task cost of each team relative to solo
svg.desc: Two panels, review and best of 3. Horizontal axis: solo's base-price cost of the task, log scale. Vertical axis: team cost over solo cost, log scale. Filled points at base prices, hollow points as billed, joined where they differ. Horizontal lines: geometric mean of per-task ratios and ratio of totals at base prices, and the billed ratio of totals.
svg.text: review: 44 of 48 above 1 at base prices
